moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio chart-draw, written here): Path in a 160x70 box: M8 57 C32 55 35 29 58 36 S92 52 111 20 S137 27 152 10, stroke 4 px accent, round caps. pathLength 1: dashoffset 1 → 0 with opacity 0 → 1, 1.2 s power2.out. Three faint horizontal grid lines (y 14 / 36 / 58) stay static. Params: duration (1.2 s) · ease (power2.out) · width (4 px). Apply to an SVG path; it draws left → right while it fades in, on the same eased clock.
